findings.claim: The machine-specific path verifier still misses Windows UNC absolute Flint roots.
findings.evidence: The acceptance evidence claims cross-platform absolute Flint-root rejection, but `findMachineSpecificPath` only checks Unix home/root paths, Windows drive-letter user profiles, Windows drive-letter Flint roots, and Unix-style absolute Flint roots; none of the patterns match an absolute UNC path such as `\\server\share\flint-gate\src\index.ts`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a UNC Flint-root pattern such as `/\\\\[^\\\s"'`]+\\[^\\\s"'`]+(?:\\[^\\\s"'`]+)*\\(?:flint-realtime-fabric|flint-gate|flint-forge)(?:\\|$)/i` and cover it with a regression.
